caveat: This registry curates historical earthquake-associated bridge outcomes. Current MPS04 PGA is a present-day reference hazard value and is never back-cast as the shaking observed at the collapse site.

eligibility_contract.rule: A case is eligible only when the bridge outcome and seismic interaction are source-backed, all core fields are populated, an independent episode_id is assigned and competing causal interpretations do not prevent a coherent process classification.

principles_retained: keep reference hazard, observed historical outcome and current bridge vulnerability separate
do not treat MPS04 PGA as site amplification, recorded shaking, collapse probability or retrofit priority
consider structural detailing, bearings, restraints, unseating, foundations, abutments, ground deformation and pre-existing degradation
require case-specific professional assessment before monitoring, retrofit or design prescriptions

production_support_contract.note: These values are a conservative abstention barrier, not a validated seismic strategy-activation threshold.
